name: Slurm HPC Cluster
label: slurm
description: Deploys and manages a Slurm HPC/AI cluster (1 head node + scalable compute nodes, optional NVIDIA GPUs) on Ubuntu 26.04 bare metal.

inputs.label: head_server_type
inputs.name: head_server_type
inputs.helpText: Head node: Slurm controller, accounting DB, NFS /shared, user login. 16+ GB RAM, disk sized for /shared. Fixed after create.

inputs.label: compute_server_type
inputs.name: compute_server_type
inputs.helpText: Server type of every compute node (CPU-only or NVIDIA GPU). Fixed after create.

inputs.label: compute_count
inputs.name: compute_count
inputs.helpText: Number of compute nodes (1-128). Edit to scale out/in; scale-in drains running jobs first.

inputs.label: os_template
inputs.name: os_template
inputs.helpText: Ubuntu 26.04 LTS is REQUIRED (e.g. ubuntu-26-04-lts-waitforssh) on all nodes; any other OS fails the preflight.

inputs.label: slurm_source
inputs.name: slurm_source
inputs.helpText: upstream: build slurm_version from SchedMD source (patched). ubuntu: Ubuntu 25.11.2 package (unpatched CVEs, admin opt-in).

inputs.label: slurm_version
inputs.name: slurm_version
inputs.helpText: SchedMD Slurm release built when slurm_source=upstream (checksum-pinned). Ignored for slurm_source=ubuntu.

inputs.label: cluster_name
inputs.name: cluster_name
inputs.helpText: Slurm ClusterName (accounting key): lowercase letter first, then lowercase letters, digits, underscore.

inputs.label: partition_name
inputs.name: partition_name
inputs.helpText: Default partition (job queue) holding all compute nodes. Must not be "default".

inputs.label: admin_username
inputs.name: admin_username
inputs.helpText: Cluster admin login (sudo + Slurm administrator). Must not be a system/OS-template user (e.g. ubuntu, root).

inputs.label: admin_ssh_public_key
inputs.name: admin_ssh_public_key
inputs.helpText: Optional extra OpenSSH public key (one line) for the admin user. A key pair is also generated (see outputs).

inputs.label: install_nvidia_driver
inputs.name: install_nvidia_driver
inputs.helpText: Install the NVIDIA driver on GPU nodes. Off: GPUs are used only if the OS image already ships a working driver.

inputs.label: install_apptainer
inputs.name: install_apptainer
inputs.helpText: Install Apptainer (HPC container runtime, from the official Apptainer PPA) on all nodes.

inputs.label: external_nfs_export
inputs.name: external_nfs_export
inputs.helpText: Optional NFS export (host:/path) mounted at /data on all nodes for datasets/results. Leave empty for none.

inputs.label: scale_in_drain_timeout_minutes
inputs.name: scale_in_drain_timeout_minutes
inputs.helpText: Scale-in: minutes to wait for jobs on removed nodes before requeue/cancel (0-720).

outputs.label: head_node_ip
outputs.name: head_node_ip
outputs.helpText: IP address of the head (login) node.

outputs.label: head_node_hostname
outputs.name: head_node_hostname
outputs.helpText: Host name of the head (login) node.

outputs.label: ssh_command
outputs.name: ssh_command
outputs.helpText: SSH command to log in to the cluster as the admin user.

outputs.label: admin_password
outputs.name: admin_password
outputs.helpText: Initial password of the admin user (changing it later is not reflected here).

outputs.label: admin_ssh_private_key
outputs.name: admin_ssh_private_key
outputs.helpText: Generated OpenSSH ed25519 private key of the admin user.

outputs.label: slurm_installed_version
outputs.name: slurm_installed_version
outputs.helpText: Slurm version running on the cluster.

outputs.label: compute_node_count
outputs.name: compute_node_count
outputs.helpText: Number of compute nodes registered in Slurm.

outputs.label: gpu_total
outputs.name: gpu_total
outputs.helpText: Total NVIDIA GPUs schedulable in the cluster.

outputs.label: data_mount
outputs.name: data_mount
outputs.helpText: External NFS export mounted at /data, or empty.

configVars.label: nvidia_driver_branch
configVars.name: nvidia_driver_branch
configVars.helpText: NVIDIA driver branch for GPU nodes: 580 (long-term support, default) or 595.

configVars.label: nvidia_blackwell_hgx_enabled
configVars.name: nvidia_blackwell_hgx_enabled
configVars.helpText: Allow HGX B200/B300 nodes (adds NVIDIA CUDA repo for nvlsm + IB tools). Experimental. Off: such nodes fail.

configVars.label: allow_ubuntu_slurm_source
configVars.name: allow_ubuntu_slurm_source
configVars.helpText: Allow tenants to choose slurm_source=ubuntu (Ubuntu 25.11.2 package with known unpatched CVEs).
